description: This Python script prepares and combines Bokeh plots for the FPE Voltages and Currents as a part of a larger monitoring dashboard. It defines multiple functions to create individual plots for various voltage and current mnemonics, combines them into a grid, and wraps them in a tab layout with descriptive HTML content. The code is intended to be imported and used as part of a dashboard system.

methods.name: dig5(conn, start, end)
methods.description: Creates a Bokeh plot for the FPE Digital 5V voltage and current mnemonics, with dual y-axes for voltage and current, including hover tools and legend.

methods.name: refdig(conn, start, end)
methods.description: Creates a plot for the 2.5V reference voltage and its associated PDU reference voltage, with hover tools and legend.

methods.name: ana5(conn, start, end)
methods.description: Creates a plot for the FPE Analogue 5V voltage and current, with dual y-axes, hover tools, and legend.

methods.name: ana5n(conn, start, end)
methods.description: Creates a plot for the FPE N5V (negative 5V) voltage and current, with dual y-axes, hover tools, and legend.

methods.name: ana7(conn, start, end)
methods.description: Creates a plot for the FPE 7V analogue voltage and current, with dual y-axes, hover tools, and legend.

methods.name: ana7n(conn, start, end)
methods.description: Creates a plot for the N7V (negative 7V) voltage and current, with dual y-axes, hover tools, and legend.

methods.name: fpe_plots(conn, start, end)
methods.description: Combines individual voltage/current plots into a grid within a tab layout, adds a descriptive HTML table, and returns the tab object for use in a dashboard.
